entries.good_example:
# Avoid eval. Use arrays or direct calls.
ls -- "$USER_INPUT"
entries.rationale: Eval is the primary vector for injection. SS QLM strictly bans eval unless no other programmatic path exists, and even then, requiring rigorous input sanitization.
Predictable filenames in /tmp allow symlink attacks. mktemp ensures unique, protected files, and traps ensure cleanup.
Permissive bits are lazy and dangerous. Least privilege (600/644) is the SS QLM standard.
